meta.name: pr-review
meta.description: Review pull requests or local diffs for correctness, regressions, missing tests, security, data safety, API compatibility, migration safety, performance risk, accessibility issues, operational hazards, and documentation drift. Use before merge, push, release, or whenever the user asks for code review, risk review, pre-landing review, or final check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码改动,提前发现回归、安全与性能风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望在合并代码前获得全面的风险审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes and catch regressions, security, and performance risks before merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to catch risks before merging code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以“最后一位把关工程师”的身份审查拉取请求或本地代码差异，重点关注真实缺陷与影响用户的风险，按严重程度输出问题清单、未决问题、测试缺口、残余风险，并给出批准或阻止建议。
howto.when: 在合并、推送、发布之前，或当你要求代码审查、风险审查、预合并检查、最终检查时会触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR，重点看安全和数据迁移风险。
say.note: Claude 会优先检查敏感数据与迁移安全问题。

say.text: 检查当前分支的本地 diff，列出测试缺口和性能风险。
say.note: 输出带严重度的问题清单。

say.text: 这份改动合并前做最终检查，有阻塞问题吗？
say.note: Claude 给出批准或阻止建议。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews PRs or local diffs as the final careful engineer, checking correctness, tests, security, migrations, performance, access, operations, and docs. Outputs prioritized findings, open questions, test gaps, residual risk, and approval/block suggestion.
howto.when_en: Triggered before merge, push, or release, or whenever the user asks for code review, risk review, pre-landing review, or final check.

say_en.text: Review this PR, focusing on security and data migration risks.
say_en.note: Claude prioritizes sensitive data and migration safety.

say_en.text: Check the local diff on this branch for test gaps and performance risks.
Do a final pre-merge check on this change. Any blockers?
say_en.note: Gives an approve or block recommendation.
